_comment: Labeled evaluation set for logic.escalator calibration. Closed-set single-label classification with KNOWN-correct labels (the `label` field; the escalator itself ignores it). Built with a DIFFICULTY GRADIENT so the resolve-level distribution is informative: (a) EASY items with explicit context that the tiny 0.5B tier should nail (resolve low, cheap); (b) NAMED-ENTITY items (brands/models) needing some world knowledge; (c) OBSCURE-ENTITY items (rare instruments/animals/vehicles/foods/plants) a 0.5B is likely to miss -- forcing escalation and exposing whether the judging tiers correct the error or rubber-stamp it (false approval). The in-set deterministic gate cannot catch an in-set-but-wrong label, so these items isolate the judge/self-consistency behaviour the calibration must measure.
